app.name: Nakhonsi360
app.tagline: Every corner of Nakhon Si Thammarat, every environmental signal.
app.mapLabel: Environmental map of Nakhon Si Thammarat Province

empty.noPublicData: No public data for this location
empty.notImported: Data from this source has not been imported yet
empty.dbNotConfigured: The database is not configured, so no data can be shown yet
empty.outsideStudyArea: This point is outside Nakhon Si Thammarat Province (including the 5 km buffer)
empty.unnamed: No name in the source data
empty.noExtent: Province boundary not imported yet, so the map shows all of Thailand

error.mapCrashed: The map ran into an error

search.label: Search places
search.noResults: No results in Nakhon Si Thammarat
search.unavailable: Search unavailable: the place-name data has not been imported yet

layers.title: Layers
layers.tooMany: {count} visible layers are on. We suggest at most {max} so the map stays readable

legend.title: Legend
legend.none: No layers with data are on the map yet

village.nearestNote: Villages are DOPA location points with no boundary; distance is to the point
village.sharedLocation: In the source this location is shared with {n} other village(s), so it may not be the village's actual position

features.osmNote: Completeness of small canals and streams in OpenStreetMap varies by area

planned.conditions: rain, water level, temperature and PM2.5
planned.hazards: earthquakes, flood, hotspots, landslide and coast
planned.satellite: latest satellite image and historical comparison

provenance.title: Data source
provenance.observedUnknown: The source does not state a date
provenance.importCounts: Records in source file {source} · imported {imported} · rejected {rejected}

controls.keyboardHint: Use arrow keys to pan the map. Press Enter to inspect the map centre

conditions.noStationRiver: No water-level station on the same waterway within {radius}
conditions.riverRuleNote: Water level only applies to its own waterway, so readings from other waterways are not shown as this point's value
conditions.elsewhere: Nearest station (a value from elsewhere, not this point)
conditions.statusNote: Status per the scale published by {source} (water level vs channel capacity)

hazards.scope: M{mag}+ within {radius} km of the province centre, last {days} days
hazards.none: No M{mag}+ earthquakes within {radius} km in the last {days} days in the USGS catalog
hazards.nearest: Nearest to this point in the same period
hazards.placeNote: Place names are in English as published by USGS; magnitude and status are USGS's own
hazards.smallNote: Smaller earthquakes in Thailand are often not in this catalog; the primary source for those is the Thai Meteorological Department

emergency.title: Emergency numbers
emergency.notConfirmed: Checked against a Government Public Relations Department notice and several publications that agree; not yet confirmed with the agency itself
emergency.provinceNote: Provincial numbers can change. If there is no answer, call 1784 or 191.
emergency.footer: Found a wrong number? Use Report (choose Other) so it can be fixed.
emergency.pageIntro: Emergency and agency hotlines. Tap a number to call. Every number shows its source and when it was checked.

report.title: Report an incident
report.sentNote: Your report is on the map. Anyone can mark that they are on the way, and you can update it from this device.
report.notEmergencyLine: Life in danger? Call first, report after
report.notEmergencyNote: Reports help everyone see what is happening, but this is not an emergency line and help is not guaranteed to come right away.
report.locationHint: Use your current location, or tap the map where it is happening.
report.gpsFailed: Could not get your location. Allow location access, or tap the map instead.
report.placeNotePlaceholder: e.g. in front of the temple, Soi 5, near the bridge
report.waterDepthHint: Compared with the body, or enter a number
report.vulnerable: Elderly, children, sick or disabled people
report.detailsPlaceholder: e.g. trapped on the 2nd floor, road cut, one way in, need regular medicine
report.contactHint: This number is shown to everyone so people coming to help can call you. It is hidden when the report is closed and deleted 30 days later.
report.publicNote: Everything you enter is shown on the map to everyone, including your name and phone if given, so people can help.
report.pickBanner: Tap the map where it is happening

errors.outside: This point is outside Nakhon Si Thammarat; only reports in the province are accepted

submitErrors.rate_limited: Too many reports from this connection. Try again shortly; if urgent call 1784.
submitErrors.outside_study_area: This point is outside the area that accepts reports.
submitErrors.database_not_configured: Reporting is not available yet. Call 1784 instead.
submitErrors.invalid: Some fields are not valid; check the messages in red.
submitErrors.failed: Could not send. Try again; if urgent call 1784.
submitErrors.network: Could not send. Check your connection and try again; your entries are kept. If urgent call 1784.

reports.title: Reports from the public
reports.lifeOpen: {n} open report(s) say lives are at risk
reports.none: No reports in the last 72 hours
reports.unverifiedNote: Reports and updates come from the public and are not official data. Check before going, and keep yourself safe.
reports.notFound: Report not found (it may have been hidden as inappropriate)

help.title: Help with this
help.intro: Anyone can help. Say what you are doing so others do not go twice. Every update shows in the progress.
help.introMine: Tell helpers the latest situation. Your updates are labelled as from the reporter.
help.notePlaceholder: Details (optional), e.g. 2 boats, there in 20 minutes
help.notePlaceholderRequired: What to add, e.g. water is up to the windows now
help.name: Your name or group
help.namePlaceholder: Name or group (optional), e.g. our village rescue volunteers
help.sent: Sent. Everyone will see it in the progress.
help.rateLimited: Too many updates; try again shortly
help.flag: This report is false or abusive
help.flagConfirm: Flag this report as false or abusive? It is hidden when several people flag it.
